boards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE stance selection comparison plate with EXACTLY FIVE full-body copies of the SAME reference character. Layout must be a STRICT THREE-COLUMN TWO-ROW grid on a genuinely transparent 1536x1024 canvas: cells top-left=1, top-middle=2, top-right=3, bottom-left=4, bottom-middle=5, bottom-right=EMPTY. Each copy wholly contained within its own 512x512 cell, with generous 25px clear gutters, common scale and feet around y=470 within each row. NO text, numbers, borders, background, shadows, magic haze or extra figures. The UI will label each option underneath. Preserve reference costume, materials, palette and painted gritty dark fantasy style. Reference is CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY: replace its existing poses entirely. Rear three-quarter from behind the left shoulder, torso and head facing screen RIGHT toward the enemy; only a little side face visible, never frontal. Exactly two arms/two hands, anatomically credible grips. These are HELD readiness stances, not action strikes or movement frames. Five clearly different poses; keep full feet, all props and weapon tips inside each cell.
CHARACTER: Same rusty closed helmet and Wayfarer plate. ONE continuous full deep crimson cape covers the back, no shredded strips. One huge straight greatsword, wielded with BOTH hands in attack and defend. No shield, no daggers.
All five options are defend HELD stances.

Cell 3: Forward middle guard. Both hands directly in FRONT at chest level, greatsword points upward-forward toward enemy-right, firm compact central guard.
Cell 4: Hanging guard. Both hands ahead of chest holding hilt high, blade hangs diagonally DOWN in the forward screen-right space; braced knees; covers incoming enemy.
